create_crossing_env: create a CrossingEnv with configurable grid size, number of crossings, and obstacle type for reinforcement learning
create_lava_crossing_env: create a LavaCrossingEnv with lava obstacles on a 9x9 grid with one crossing for RL training
create_simple_crossing_env: create a SimpleCrossingEnv with wall obstacles on a 9x9 grid with one crossing for RL training
customize_crossing_grid: customize the CrossingEnv grid by setting size, num_crossings, and obstacle_type to Lava or Wall
register_minigrid_env: register a MiniGrid crossing environment variant with a unique ID and entry point for gym access
